newsitem.title: USA: Ulster Unionist leader meets top U.S. officials.
newsitem.headline: Ulster Unionist leader meets top U.S. officials.

text.p: The leader of a pro-British Protestant party of Northern Ireland held talks on Tuesday with Vice President Al Gore and National Security Adviser Anthony Lake on prospects for the peace process.
David Trimble, head of the centrist Ulster Unionist Party, said he and the top U.S. officials had a "friendly cooperative discussion" on Northern Ireland.

A White House official said Trimble expressed appreciation for the "steadfastness" of Clinton's Irish envoy, former Maine Sen. George Mitchell. Mitchell has strongly denied his mixed Irish ancestry will compromise his neutrality at the latest round of Northern Ireland peace talks.
The talks have been delayed for months by Unionist attempts to limit Mitchell's powers because of what they said were his sympathies for Irish nationalists.

Trimble told reporters his group expressed scepticism about the desire of the Irish Republican Army's political wing, Sinn Fein, for a lasting ceasefire in the 27-year Northern Ireland conflict which has killed 3,200 people.
Sinn Fein is barred from the talks until the IRA restores a ceasefire it broke in February with bombs in Britain, Germany and Northern Ireland.
He said the group discussed British Prime Minister John Major's conditions for Sinn Fein to be allowed into the talks.

Major told parliament on Thursday the IRA, which wants to end British rule and see the province reunified with the Irish republic, would have to call a credible and verifiable ceasefire before Sinn Fein could be admitted to the negotiations.
"We also discussed with them our desire to see the inter-party talks move forward positively in order to show there is something concrete coming out of the political process," Trimble said.
"We were generally in agreement. There was an exchange of views on the details," he said.
A White House official said the meeting lasted about an hour and 15 minutes, with Gore present for 15 minutes and Lake present the entire time.
